page.layout: Two columns of word-list entries, left and right, side by side. Running head centred at top ("DIVERSIS."), page number at top right. Signature mark at bottom right of the right column.
page.notes: Left column: 22 lines of entries from "Galle" to "Iltis", with a gap after "Gänßscherer Betler". Right column: entries from "Pfaw." to "Starkknecht.". "Verzerte / verkräckte handwercksknecht." runs over two printed lines as one entry. "Messer/oder Dägen" is uncertain: the last word could be Dägen or another Fraktur form. Several initial capitals (G, H, J) are printed with decorative shapes and read with some uncertainty. "Stücklinbrot:" ends with a colon-like mark. "L 3" at the foot is a printed gathering signature.
